## Design

### 2026-10-24 – Followed the MIDI keypad tutorial and built the schematic in KiCad with the ESP32-S3-Zero, touch keys, buttons, rotary encoder, sliders and LEDs. I had to change the schematic layout a few times so th

**7h**

Followed the MIDI keypad tutorial and built the schematic in KiCad with the ESP32-S3-Zero, touch keys, buttons, rotary encoder, sliders and LEDs. I had to change the schematic layout a few times so the PCB would be easier to wire up. I designed my own touch keys and spent ages getting the dimensions just right. When I tried to connect the keys to the ESP32 they only joined to the switch, so I had to fix the connections in the schematic and update the board. I downloaded the Freerouting plugin and had a lot of trouble with it, mostly Java errors, but I got it working and routed the rest of the board. After that I went through the DRC errors, like parts too close together and too close to the board edge, and fixed them. I also installed the plugin from the guide that exports all the production files and used it to get a quote from the PCB manufacturer.

### 2026-10-25 – Imported the PCB from KiCad into Fusion 360 and designed a detailed enclosure around it. I added all the STEP models of the parts so I could check the fit, and made a render. I made cutouts for the th

**5h**

Imported the PCB from KiCad into Fusion 360 and designed a detailed enclosure around it. I added all the STEP models of the parts so I could check the fit, and made a render. I made cutouts for the three buttons, the rotary encoder with its knob, and both sliders, and left the touch key area open so the keys can be touched directly. I spent a lot of time getting the dimensions and gaps right so everything lines up with the board, and rounded the corners to make it look cleaner.
